evidence: The reactor was maintained continuously under a pressure of 1–3 kPa. The excess amount of precursor, i.e. /C24 2.5 mmol per gram of support ensured the complete saturation of the support. Following the precursor adsorption, the powders were subsequently purged with nitrogen at the same temperature for 2 h and calcined in-situ under oxygen flow at 773 K for 11 h.
